description: Grades one answer to a Rotate Pilot practice question, identified by its question_id. Returns whether it is correct, the correct letter and text, the explanation and its citations (14 CFR, AIM, ACS code when available). Accepts a letter (A/B/C), a number 1-3 or the option text.

answer.description: The user's answer: A, B, C (or 1-3, or the option text).

question_id.description: The question_id of a Rotate Pilot practice question.

name: check_answer
title: Check a practice answer
